list.name: repo
list.label: Repo
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT repo FROM pr_metrics ORDER BY repo

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence IN ('definite', 'likely') AND repo IN ($repo)
SELECT count(*) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence = 'none' AND repo IN ($repo)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE gate_policy_blocked = true)::float / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE gate_policy_blocked IS NOT NULL), 0) FROM pr_metrics WHERE repo IN ($repo)
SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE consistency_finding_count > 0)::float / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE consistency_finding_count IS NOT NULL), 0) FROM pr_metrics WHERE repo IN ($repo)

panels.title: AI vs Human PR Volume Over Time

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely')) AS ai, count(*) FILTER (WHERE confidence = 'none') AS human FROM pr_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND repo IN ($repo) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg. Time to Merge (minutes) — AI vs Human
panels.description: Mean is sensitive to outliers — see the Mean ÷ Median Skew panels below before drawing conclusions from this alone.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, avg(time_to_merge_minutes) FILTER (WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely')) AS ai, avg(time_to_merge_minutes) FILTER (WHERE confidence = 'none') AS human FROM pr_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND repo IN ($repo) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) FROM escape_records WHERE detection_method IN ('manual', 'commit-linked') AND repo IN ($repo)

panels.title: Escaped Defects — Heuristic (best-effort)
panels.description: Time-window correlation, not a confirmed causal link — see FR-5.6.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM escape_records WHERE detection_method = 'time-window-heuristic' AND repo IN ($repo)

panels.title: AI — Definite
panels.description: PRs with a Co-Authored-By AI trailer (highest-confidence signal).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence = 'definite' AND repo IN ($repo)

panels.title: AI — Likely
panels.description: PRs matching an AI branch pattern or PR-template marker, but no commit trailer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence = 'likely' AND repo IN ($repo)

panels.title: Avg Review Comments — AI
panels.description: Mean review_comment_count for AI-authored PRs (definite + likely).

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(review_comment_count)::numeric, 1) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence IN ('definite', 'likely') AND repo IN ($repo)
SELECT round(avg(review_comment_count)::numeric, 1) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence = 'none' AND repo IN ($repo)

panels.title: Avg. Time to First Review (minutes) — AI vs Human
panels.description: How quickly PRs receive a first review, split by authorship.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, avg(time_to_first_review_minutes) FILTER (WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely')) AS ai, avg(time_to_first_review_minutes) FILTER (WHERE confidence = 'none') AS human FROM pr_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND repo IN ($repo) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg. Review Comment Count — AI vs Human
panels.description: Weekly average reviewer engagement per PR, by authorship.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, avg(review_comment_count) FILTER (WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely')) AS ai, avg(review_comment_count) FILTER (WHERE confidence = 'none') AS human FROM pr_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND repo IN ($repo) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Avg Consistency Findings per AI PR
panels.description: Mean number of naming/error-handling findings on AI-authored PRs (confidence: definite or likely) where the consistency checker ran.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round(avg(consistency_finding_count)::numeric, 1) FROM pr_metrics WHERE consistency_finding_count IS NOT NULL AND confidence IN ('definite', 'likely') AND repo IN ($repo)

panels.title: Escaped Defects Over Time
panels.description: Weekly count of newly-detected escapes, split by detection method.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', detected_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE detection_method IN ('manual','commit-linked')) AS confirmed, count(*) FILTER (WHERE detection_method = 'time-window-heuristic') AS heuristic FROM escape_records WHERE $__timeFilter(detected_at) AND repo IN ($repo) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

options.content:
## Distribution — why the mean alone is misleading
Cycle-time data is almost always right-skewed: most PRs merge quickly, but a handful of very slow outliers drag the **mean** far above what's typical. The panels below show the **median (p50)** and tail percentiles (p75/p90/p95) alongside the mean, so a single slow PR can't masquerade as 'the AI PRs are 10x slower' when the typical case is much closer.

panels.title: Time-to-Merge Percentiles (minutes) — AI vs Human
panels.description: p50 is the median: half of PRs in that group merged faster than this, half slower. Compare p50 to the mean to see how much outliers are skewing the average.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN confidence IN ('definite','likely') THEN 'AI' ELSE 'Human' END AS group, count(*) AS n, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_merge_minutes)) AS p50_median, round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_merge_minutes)) AS p75, round(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_merge_minutes)) AS p90, round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_merge_minutes)) AS p95, round(avg(time_to_merge_minutes)) AS mean FROM pr_metrics WHERE repo IN ($repo) AND time_to_merge_minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Time-to-First-Review Percentiles (minutes) — AI vs Human
panels.description: Same breakdown as the merge-time panel, for how long a PR waits for its first reviewer comment.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN confidence IN ('definite','likely') THEN 'AI' ELSE 'Human' END AS group, count(*) AS n, round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_first_review_minutes)) AS p50_median, round(percentile_cont(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_first_review_minutes)) AS p75, round(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_first_review_minutes)) AS p90, round(percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_first_review_minutes)) AS p95, round(avg(time_to_first_review_minutes)) AS mean FROM pr_metrics WHERE repo IN ($repo) AND time_to_first_review_minutes IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Mean ÷ Median Skew — AI (time to merge)
panels.description: 1.0 means a normal, symmetric distribution. The higher this goes, the more a few slow outliers (not typical behavior) are inflating the average — a ratio of 5+ means 'the mean is lying to you'.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round( (avg(time_to_merge_minutes) / NULLIF(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_merge_minutes), 0))::numeric, 1) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely') AND repo IN ($repo)

panels.title: Mean ÷ Median Skew — Human (time to merge)
panels.description: Same ratio, computed for human-authored PRs only, for comparison against the AI figure to the left.

targets.rawSql: SELECT round( (avg(time_to_merge_minutes) / NULLIF(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_merge_minutes), 0))::numeric, 1) FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence = 'none' AND repo IN ($repo)

panels.title: Slowest AI-authored PRs (time to merge)
panels.description: The actual outliers behind the AI mean/median gap — useful for spot-checking whether a handful of unusual PRs (not typical AI behavior) are driving the headline number.

targets.rawSql: SELECT repo, pr_id, time_to_merge_minutes, review_comment_count FROM pr_metrics WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely') AND repo IN ($repo) AND time_to_merge_minutes IS NOT NULL ORDER BY time_to_merge_minutes DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Median Time to Merge (minutes) — AI vs Human
panels.description: Same weekly breakdown as the 'Avg.' panel above, but using the median instead of the mean — compare the two to see how much outlier weeks are distorting the average view.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('week', created_at) AS time, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_merge_minutes) FILTER (WHERE confidence IN ('definite','likely')) AS ai, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_merge_minutes) FILTER (WHERE confidence = 'none') AS human FROM pr_metrics WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) AND repo IN ($repo) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
